comments.text:
My personal thoughts on the patch:


Overall, very enjoyable, but I do have a few problems one of them being I don’t like the change that they did for books and other readable items I liked the system they had where every readable item have their own designated spot in your inventory, so it didn’t clutter other than that. Everything else they’ve done with the inventory has been absolutely perfect being able to finally organize what I have has been a major help.


The inclusion of a difficulty slider is awesome. I’m very much enjoying my time on normal, but I won’t lie. It could be very challenging sometimes so I like to slide it down to get easy when I just wanna relax and explore the world and do things and bump it up to hard if I wanna test myself


They finally added a bridge from the camp to the home thank God now I don’t have to climb or fly or go around just to get to my own house. Amazing change. I’m also loving the inclusion of the new home items. The closet where you store all of your armor is amazing and I love the cuckoo fridge.



One grip that I have right now is that apparently this patch broke the legendary animals and mounts you can’t summon them and they don’t exist anymore. This might just be a bug but I’m hoping that they put out a hot fix soon to address this issue because right now I can’t even call the wyvern


Love the new pets, especially the bird pets. They did not have to do this but they did anyway and I love them for it. Can’t wait for them to add customization options for them.


Overall, my ranking of this update is a solid 8 out of 10 it’s got some hiccups, but overall it’s a very good update and I can’t wait for the next one


Update: as I just finished writing this, they just put out another update. It’s like likely a hot fix to address the animal issue.
